content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps. The investigator did not interview S1, the main alleged discriminator and the person who made the 'I thought you were gay' comment and assigned the extra events, although S2's account of the rebalancing and S1's input on the removal also depend on him. C1, the comparator who received the LGBTQ portfolio, was not interviewed and there is no demographic or protected-activity information about C1. There is also no documentation of the claimed workload rebalancing, such as other portfolio changes or workload data, to test the stated reason and pretext. The hostile work environment claim (scrutiny, criticism, scheduling) has little evidence beyond S2's general denial and C2's partial account. Reprisal was dismissed on a legal ground without an inquiry into whether opposition to discrimination (telling S1 and S2 that assignments could not rest on assumptions about group membership) was protected activity. The decision therefore cannot be reliably evaluated on the merits from this record."}
